carrier_chain: applied outcome with closed recovery validity
carrier_type: Internal sealed IDisposable, no general getter/record printing/deconstruction/automatic JSON; one-shot move, exact actor/owner/request/set/context/profile binding, idempotent owned-buffer disposal.
clone_rule: ForPasskey/ForTotp copy all unrelated validity fields and move/preserve the same carrier intentionally. Separate closed-shape validation rejects unsupported combinations; nothing is silently nulled or converted into an auth bypass.

final_validity.placement: Existing StepUpApplication final decisionAt after all awaited owner/source/native checks
final_validity.dependency: Optional IRecoveryCodePolicySource plus closed RecoveryCodeExecutionValidity; no RecoveryCodeApplication dependency cycle or generic validation callback.
receipt_fields: owner operation/correlation/context digest and expected resource version
exact expected prior-set retirement plan and resulting transaction-pinned rows
final_validity.checks: Synchronous current effective policy re-resolution, exact scope/actor/row/plan/source/interval checks. Bind/revalidate impact-relevant usage facts through separate usage version/facts digest without bumping lifecycle version for ordinary use. All existing proof/session/contact/method/assurance/expiry/receipt checks remain independent.
final_validity.causal_source: Recovery validity is not added to the existing passkey/TOTP causal-source exemption. Initial recovery adapter makes no proof-source or session mutation.

failure_frontiers.rule: Owner local finally disposes before returning conflict; no mutation/proof/outbox commit.
Rollback all owner/proof/effects/outbox and dispose pending delivery.

failure_frontiers.frontier: Save/commit failure or cancellation with UNKNOWN commit
failure_frontiers.rule: Dispose; never return pending codes even if a later read finds committed completion.
Do not transfer before leaving await-using block successfully; outer pending guard disposes.
Execution-result guard disposes; safe exact status can be read later, no payload recovery.
Dedicated result emits no payload and disposes. Committed owner state is not falsely called rolled back.
Result finally disposes; bytes already sent cannot be promised erased. Later COMPLETED says codes unavailable, never shown/saved.
Only safe factory available; no shared-owner cache or reconstructed payload.

normalization_limit: Clear only owned mutable buffers; native immutable strings, managed copies and authorized network receipt cannot be claimed exhaustively erased.
safe_result_factory: Keep ProofCompleted safe-only. Add a dedicated bound recovery first-delivery IResult called only on actual committed Applied; do not give reconciliation helpers an optional secret parameter.
